summary: Completed comprehensive testing of India Explorer tourism website iteration 2. Backend APIs maintain 100% success rate. Frontend shows significant improvement with the critical search overlay issue from iteration 1 now FIXED. All core features are working excellently including accurate political map, state navigation, search functionality, and detailed pages.
passed_tests: Backend API root endpoint (200 OK)
Get all 36 states/UTs endpoint with correct count
Get specific state (Rajasthan) with 3 places
Get specific place (Taj Mahal) with related places
Search functionality for multiple queries (Taj Mahal, Rajasthan, UNESCO, temple)
Categories endpoint returning 8 categories
Error handling for invalid endpoints (404)
Homepage loads with accurate India SVG political map (@svg-maps/india)
Map hover effects work correctly - color changes to terracotta (#C65D47)
Map hover tooltip shows state name and region
Clicking Rajasthan on map navigates to /state/rajasthan
Clicking Kerala on map navigates to /state/kerala
Search overlay opens with nav button and displays results for 'Taj Mahal'
Search overlay closes properly with X button (FIXED from iteration 1)
State detail page shows hero, description, highlights, and category filters
Category filter pills work correctly (All, Fort filters tested)
Places grid displayed with correct count on state pages
Place detail page loads with title (Hawa Mahal), about section, visitor info sidebar
Visitor info sidebar shows all elements (how to reach, opening times, entry fee, contact)
Related/nearby attractions section displays correctly
Back navigation buttons functional throughout app
All 36 state cards visible in states grid section below map
Footer displays correctly with India Explorer branding and states info

success_percentage.frontend: 100% - All core features working, search overlay issue from iteration 1 fixed
